label: Juniper & Shear, hair studio
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bodoni+Moda:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..96,400..700;1,6..96,400..700&family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300..700;1,9..144,300..700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Syne:wght@600;700;800&display=swap');
  /* Juniper & Shear: a hair studio in Freiburg. One 78rem grid on full-width bands; the hero puts the promise beside
     an arched mirror with a note pinned to it (the next free slot); the price menu reprices by length and level; the
     colour band shows a balayage before and after and where its processing time goes. Manrope for the text, the
     display face per look: Bodoni Moda (Salon), Syne (Neon), Fraunces (Botanical). */
  #in-salon {
    --background: oklch(0.975 0.012 75);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.03 20);
    --card: oklch(0.995 0.006 75);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --popover: oklch(0.995 0.006 75);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.94 0.015 60);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.03 25);
    --border: oklch(0.22 0.03 20 / 0.13);
    --input: oklch(0.22 0.03 20 / 0.24);
    --primary: oklch(0.5 0.13 25);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.01 75);
    --secondary: oklch(0.93 0.025 45);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.05 25);
    --accent: oklch(0.93 0.02 55);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.22 0.03 20);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.55 0.13 25);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.72 0.1 75);
    --chart-3: oklch(0.45 0.08 340);
    --chart-4: oklch(0.6 0.06 150);
    --chart-5: oklch(0.78 0.05 60);
    --radius: 0.25rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --hs-band: oklch(0.945 0.02 55);
    --hs-display: 'Bodoni Moda', Didot, Georgia, serif;
    --hs-display-weight: 500;
    --hs-ink: var(--primary);
    --hs-stroke: 1.75px;
    --hs-glow: none;
    --hs-note: oklch(0.985 0.03 85);
    --hs-note-ink: oklch(0.25 0.03 30);
    --hs-gift: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.5 0.13 25), oklch(0.36 0.1 15));
    --hs-gift-ink: oklch(0.97 0.02 75);
    --hs-gift-line: oklch(0.82 0.09 80);
    --hs-bottle: oklch(0.36 0.06 25);
    --hs-label: oklch(0.93 0.03 70);
    --hs-open: oklch(0.48 0.13 150);
    accent-color: var(--primary);
    color-scheme: light;
    container-type: inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.6 'Manrope',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='neon'] {
    --background: oklch(0.97 0.012 320);
    --foreground: oklch(0.2 0.05 300);
    --card: oklch(0.995 0.005 320);
    --popover: oklch(0.995 0.005 320);
    --muted: oklch(0.93 0.02 320);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.06 305);
    --border: oklch(0.2 0.05 300 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.2 0.05 300 / 0.26);
    --primary: oklch(0.52 0.24 350);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.99 0.005 320);
    --secondary: oklch(0.92 0.04 320);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.12 330);
    --accent: oklch(0.92 0.03 320);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.2 0.05 300);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.6 0.24 350);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.7 0.14 210);
    --chart-3: oklch(0.55 0.2 300);
    --chart-4: oklch(0.8 0.16 90);
    --chart-5: oklch(0.75 0.1 320);
    --radius: 0.75rem;
    --hs-band: oklch(0.935 0.025 315);
    --hs-display: 'Syne', 'Arial Black', sans-serif;
    --hs-display-weight: 700;
    --hs-ink: oklch(0.6 0.25 350);
    --hs-stroke: 3px;
    --hs-glow: drop-shadow(0 0 4px oklch(0.7 0.25 350 / 0.9)) drop-shadow(0 0 10px oklch(0.7 0.25 350 / 0.6));
    --hs-note: oklch(0.17 0.04 295);
    --hs-note-ink: oklch(0.93 0.03 320);
    --hs-gift: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.16 0.04 295), oklch(0.22 0.07 310));
    --hs-gift-ink: oklch(0.96 0.02 320);
    --hs-gift-line: oklch(0.72 0.2 350);
    --hs-bottle: oklch(0.24 0.08 300);
    --hs-label: oklch(0.72 0.2 350);
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='botanical'] {
    --background: oklch(0.96 0.02 120);
    --foreground: oklch(0.24 0.04 150);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.01 110);
    --popover: oklch(0.985 0.01 110);
    --muted: oklch(0.92 0.03 125);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.43 0.04 145);
    --border: oklch(0.24 0.04 150 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.24 0.04 150 / 0.26);
    --primary: oklch(0.42 0.08 150);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.98 0.01 110);
    --secondary: oklch(0.91 0.04 125);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.06 150);
    --accent: oklch(0.91 0.035 125);
    --accent-foreground: oklch(0.24 0.04 150);
    --chart-1: oklch(0.5 0.09 150);
    --chart-2: oklch(0.75 0.1 95);
    --chart-3: oklch(0.6 0.08 40);
    --chart-4: oklch(0.7 0.07 180);
    --chart-5: oklch(0.82 0.05 120);
    --radius: 1.25rem;
    --hs-band: oklch(0.925 0.03 120);
    --hs-display: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
    --hs-display-weight: 400;
    --hs-ink: oklch(0.5 0.1 145);
    --hs-stroke: 3.5px;
    --hs-glow: none;
    --hs-note: oklch(0.82 0.05 75);
    --hs-note-ink: oklch(0.26 0.04 60);
    --hs-gift: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.8 0.05 75), oklch(0.72 0.06 70));
    --hs-gift-ink: oklch(0.24 0.04 60);
    --hs-gift-line: oklch(0.42 0.08 150);
    --hs-bottle: oklch(0.42 0.08 150);
    --hs-label: oklch(0.9 0.04 100);
  }
  #in-salon [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  /* one 78rem grid: every band runs full width, its content inside the computed padding */
  #in-salon > :is(header, section, footer) {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding-inline: max(clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
  }
  #in-salon > section {
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem);
    scroll-margin-top: 4.5rem;
  }
  #in-salon > .hs-band {
    background: var(--hs-band);
  }
  #in-salon :is(h1, h2, h3) {
    font-family: var(--hs-display);
    font-weight: var(--hs-display-weight);
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #in-salon a:not(.btn, .nav-menu-link, .mk-header-brand) {
    color: inherit;
    text-underline-offset: 0.25em;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='salon'] .hs-look-only[data-for='salon'],
  #in-salon[data-look='neon'] .hs-look-only[data-for='neon'],
  #in-salon[data-look='botanical'] .hs-look-only[data-for='botanical'] {
    display: block;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-eyebrow {
    margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-head {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem 3rem;
    margin-block-end: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-head h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 1.4rem + 2.6cqi, 3.4rem);
    line-height: 1.05;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-head p:not(.hs-eyebrow) {
    max-width: 34rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  /* the header: brand, the sections at reading size, the look and the mode together, Book */
  #in-salon .hs-bar {
    padding-inline: max(clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 90%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-inner {
    max-width: none;
    padding-inline: 0;
    gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-brand,
  #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-name {
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-name {
    font: var(--hs-display-weight) 1.35rem/1 var(--hs-display);
    letter-spacing: 0;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-brand svg {
    width: 1.6rem;
    height: 1.6rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-nav {
    margin-inline-end: auto;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .nav-menu-link {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .nav-menu-link:hover {
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-bar .nav-menu-link[aria-current] {
    color: var(--foreground);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary);
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-controls .select {
    width: auto;
  }
  #in-salon .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-salon .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 66rem) {
    #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-nav {
      display: none;
    }
    #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-menu {
      display: inline-flex;
    }
    #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-brand {
      margin-inline-end: auto;
    }
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 26rem) {
    #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-name {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }
    #in-salon .hs-bar .mk-header-brand svg {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  /* the hero: the promise beside an arched mirror; a note is pinned to the mirror (the next free slot) */
  #in-salon .hs-hero {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);
    padding-block: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-hero h1 {
    margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
    font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 1.6rem + 5cqi, 5.6rem);
    line-height: 0.98;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-hero-lede {
    max-width: 33rem;
    margin: 0 0 2rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-facts {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem 1.75rem;
    margin: 2.25rem 0 0;
    padding: 1.25rem 0 0;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
    list-style: none;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-facts li {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-facts svg {
    width: 1.1rem;
    height: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--primary);
  }
  /* the circled word, drawn per look */
  #in-salon .hs-circled {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-circled svg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -18% -14% -22% -12%;
    width: 126%;
    height: 140%;
    overflow: visible;
    pointer-events: none;
    filter: var(--hs-glow);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-circled path {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--hs-ink);
    stroke-width: var(--hs-stroke);
    stroke-linecap: round;
    vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='botanical'] .hs-circled path {
    stroke-dasharray: 14 5 2 5;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-mirror {
    position: relative;
    justify-self: center;
    width: min(100%, 30rem);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-mirror-glass {
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 50% 50% var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg) / 38% 38% var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-mirror-glass img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 50% 50% var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) / 36% 36% var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md);
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='neon'] .hs-mirror-glass {
    border: 2px solid var(--hs-ink);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 12px oklch(0.7 0.25 350 / 0.55),
      inset 0 0 12px oklch(0.7 0.25 350 / 0.35);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-note {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    inset: auto -1.25rem 2.5rem auto;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    max-width: 14.5rem;
    padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: var(--hs-note);
    color: var(--hs-note-ink);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.35;
    text-align: start;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -12px oklch(0.2 0.03 30 / 0.45);
    rotate: 3deg;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      rotate 0.25s ease,
      translate 0.25s ease;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-note::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -0.45rem;
    left: 50%;
    width: 0.9rem;
    height: 0.9rem;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 2px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35);
    translate: -50% 0;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-note:hover {
    rotate: 0deg;
    translate: 0 -2px;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-note:focus-visible {
    outline: 3px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-note small {
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    opacity: 0.75;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-note strong {
    font: var(--hs-display-weight) 1.2rem/1.15 var(--hs-display);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-note span {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='neon'] .hs-note {
    border: 1.5px solid var(--hs-ink);
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px oklch(0.7 0.25 350 / 0.5);
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='neon'] .hs-note::before {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='botanical'] .hs-note {
    border-radius: 0.4rem 0.4rem 0.4rem 1.6rem;
    rotate: -4deg;
  }
  #in-salon[data-look='botanical'] .hs-note::before {
    width: 0.55rem;
    height: 0.55rem;
    background: var(--hs-note);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--hs-note-ink);
    top: 0.5rem;
    left: 1rem;
  }
  /* the hero's look layers: a stamp, a neon sign, a pressed sprig - each says something */
  #in-salon .hs-stamp {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    top: 1.5rem;
    left: -2.5rem;
    width: 7.5rem;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    color: var(--primary);
    rotate: -14deg;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-stamp text {
    font:
      600 9.2px/1 'Manrope',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    fill: currentColor;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-stamp circle {
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-stamp circle:first-of-type {
    fill: var(--background);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-stamp .hs-stamp-mid {
    font: 500 15px/1 var(--hs-display);
    letter-spacing: 0;
    text-transform: none;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-sign {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    top: 1.25rem;
    left: -1.75rem;
    padding: 0.7rem 1rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 0.6rem;
    background: oklch(0.13 0.03 295);
    color: oklch(0.97 0.03 340);
    font:
      700 1.05rem/1.05 'Syne',
      sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-shadow:
      0 0 3px oklch(0.75 0.25 350),
      0 0 10px oklch(0.7 0.25 350),
      0 0 22px oklch(0.65 0.25 350);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px oklch(0.1 0.03 295 / 0.6);
    rotate: -6deg;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-sign small {
    display: block;
    margin-block-start: 0.3rem;
    color: oklch(0.92 0.08 200);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    text-shadow:
      0 0 3px oklch(0.8 0.13 200),
      0 0 10px oklch(0.75 0.13 200);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-sprig {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    top: 0.5rem;
    left: -2.75rem;
    width: 11rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-sprig svg {
    display: block;
    width: 5.5rem;
    color: var(--hs-ink);
    rotate: -20deg;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-sprig p {
    margin: -0.5rem 0 0 2.75rem;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 0.3rem;
    background: var(--hs-note);
    color: var(--hs-note-ink);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.3;
    rotate: 4deg;
  }
  /* prices: length and level are radio cards; the menu reprices from them */
  #in-salon .hs-pickers {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 22rem), 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem 2.5rem;
    margin-block-end: 2.5rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-pickers .radio-group {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-pickers legend {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    margin-block-end: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-pickers .radio-card {
    min-width: 0;
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-pickers .radio-card:has(:checked) {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-menu {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 28rem), 1fr));
    gap: 2.5rem clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-menu h3 {
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
    padding-block-end: 0.6rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--foreground);
    font-size: 1.6rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-menu ol {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.15rem 1rem;
    padding-block: 1rem;
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-salon .hs-item h4 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-item p {
    grid-column: 1;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-price {
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
    font: var(--hs-display-weight) 1.35rem/1.2 var(--hs-display);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    text-align: end;
  }
  #in-salon .hs-meta {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin-block-start: 0.4rem;
